'''Eara Lota''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the rightful heir to the throne of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Raised in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], Eara Lota was the niece of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Alor Keto/Legends|Alor Keto]], the ruler of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. During her youth, Lota protested the living conditions that the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of [[Ronika/Legends|Ronika]] were subjected to, as well as the working environments of [[Miner/Legends|miners]] throughout the system.<ref name="NoP" />
